mapper.select: SELECT sn.id, sn.stock_code, sn.keyword, sn.title, COALESCE(nas.summary, sn.summary) AS summary, nas.summary AS ai_summary, ns.sentiment, ns.sentiment_score, ns.impact_score, sn.origin_url, sn.origin_url_hash, sn.naver_link, sn.publisher, sn.published_at, sn.collected_at FROM stock_news sn LEFT JOIN news_ai_summary nas ON nas.news_id = sn.id LEFT JOIN news_sentiment ns ON ns.news_id = sn.id WHERE sn.stock_code = #{stockCode} ORDER BY sn.published_at DESC, sn.collected_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT sn.id, sn.stock_code, sn.keyword, sn.title, COALESCE(nas.summary, sn.summary) AS summary, nas.summary AS ai_summary, ns.sentiment, ns.sentiment_score, ns.impact_score, sn.origin_url, sn.origin_url_hash, sn.naver_link, sn.publisher, sn.published_at, sn.collected_at FROM stock_news sn LEFT JOIN news_ai_summary nas ON nas.news_id = sn.id LEFT JOIN news_sentiment ns ON ns.news_id = sn.id WHERE sn.stock_code = #{stockCode} AND sn.published_at IS NOT NULL AND sn.published_at >= #{since} ORDER BY sn.published_at DESC, sn.collected_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT sn.id, sn.stock_code, sn.keyword, sn.title, sn.summary, sn.origin_url, sn.origin_url_hash, sn.naver_link, sn.publisher, sn.published_at, sn.collected_at FROM stock_news sn LEFT JOIN news_ai_summary nas ON nas.news_id = sn.id LEFT JOIN news_sentiment ns ON ns.news_id = sn.id WHERE nas.id IS NULL OR ns.id IS NULL ORDER BY sn.published_at DESC, sn.collected_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
